feedback_use: Round 1 reduced wirelength in all six cells, but the two sub-1.0 cells both increased overflow. The change retains the successful relief schedule while adding a small congestion-defense floor specifically for stalled regression at low urgency.
hypothesis: Preventing congestion-cost relief during low-overflow stalled regressions should preserve most wirelength gains while reducing the costly near-convergence overflow increases seen in the weaker seeds.
